contract: Query sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN) once and cast its c_long to i32. Keep the -1 sentinel and ordinary errno behavior. This is the system online count, not affinity-limited available_parallelism.
fixtures: Linux compares against getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN. Unix checks a positive query result and caller errno preservation for zero, EIO and an arbitrary raw sentinel, restoring original errno before assertions.
limits: The Linux count comparison assumes no CPU hotplug between its two queries. macOS currently has errno/positive-result coverage but no independent exact-count fixture. Incoming-errno-dependent interposed libc behavior is not covered.
candidate: Existing nix SysconfVar::_NPROCESSORS_ONLN with the private errno-preserving helper introduced by PR #148, after that change is integrated. Keep the existing i32 cast; do not substitute available_parallelism.
deletion_gate: Remove the direct Unix processor-count unsafe block only after baseline validation, reviewed replacement tests and native inventory evidence. Windows remains outside this increment.
